Q5786.reason: Avoidable consequences limits recovery to the wound and pain up to the refusal; religious refusal is not contributory negligence and does not automatically create full wrongful-death liability.

Q5253.reason: Contingent remainders are the nonvested interests the Rule Against Perpetuities limits and the only one of these four that was destructible at common law.

Q5347.reason: Stored ATP is the initial fuel and covers only about 1–2 seconds of maximal contraction before phosphocreatine regenerates it.
